name: OPPORTUNITY — Locomotion
sensor_type: Body-worn IMUs + object sensors + ambient sensors
placement: 7 IMUs (body) + 12 object sensors (on daily objects) + ambient sensors
channel_description: 113 OPPORTUNITY challenge sensor channels after removing quaternion/orientation and unused columns. Use ADL runs only (not Drill runs). Null/unannotated labels are excluded from canonical evaluation.

protocol.note: Use ADL run only. Report mean ± std across all 4 LOSO folds.

description: Same sensor setup as Track A. Track B targets 4 evaluated locomotion classes (Stand, Walk, Sit, Lie). Null/unannotated periods are excluded before windowing and evaluation. The task is to segment the stream into 1 second windows with 50% overlap and classify each window into one of the 4 evaluated classes. Use ADL runs only. Use Leave-One-Subject-Out cross validation across all 4 subjects. Report mean and standard deviation across the 4 folds.
